finding.summary: Blank-skipping in `Arguments.iterate` silently changes AND/OR/XOR semantics over cell ranges, and no test anywhere passes a range to those functions
finding.evidence: The diff changes the shared `Arguments.iterate` (packages/sheets/src/formula/arguments.ts:110-125) to skip blank cells for *every* range, not just unbounded ones. `BoolArgs.iterate` is used by AND/OR/XOR (packages/sheets/src/formula/functions-logical.ts:111, 133, 174), so e.g. `=AND(A1:A3)` with A2 blank changes from FALSE (blank→false) to TRUE. Every AND/OR/XOR test in the suite uses literal arguments only (packages/sheets/test/formula/formula.test.ts:455-470, 1066-1067, 1325-1328); grepping the test tree for `AND(A`/`OR(A` over a range returns nothing. The new tests in this diff only exercise SUM/AVERAGE/COUNT, so the boolean-aggregation behavior change ships with zero coverage.
